name: Air-cooled HGX B300 rack (4 x 8-GPU servers)
model: 4 x DGX/HGX B300 10U air-cooled servers in a 48U MGX rack
description: Four air-cooled 10U HGX B300 8-GPU servers (32 GPUs) per 48U rack, following NVIDIA's DGX B300 high-density deployment pattern: MGX-style rack with an integrated rear 54 V DC busbar fed by four 1U 33 kW power shelves (N+1, at least three active), plus an active rear door heat exchanger (RDHx) to remove the air heat at the rack. Per server: 8 B300 GPUs, 2 Xeon 6776P CPUs, 8 ConnectX-8 800G ports, 2 dual-port BlueField-3, ~14.5 kW, 10U. OEM HGX B300 servers with their own AC PSUs fit the same profile; a low-density variant puts 2 AC-PDU-fed servers per rack (~30 kW average, 39.4 kW peak, 1,301 kg). Change the chassis count by overriding power and weight.

nominal_power_w.note: NVIDIA: 58 kW average for 4 DC-busbar B300 systems per rack (estimated by NVIDIA at 25 C supply air); 4 x 14.5 kW system power

peak_power_w.note: NVIDIA: 76 kW peak per 4-system rack (19 kW estimated peak per busbar system)

power_shelves.note: four 1U 33 kW DC power shelves per rack, N+1

liquid_fraction.note: air-cooled servers; all heat leaves the servers in air. An active RDHx (recommended by NVIDIA at 4 systems per rack) moves that air heat to water at the rack door, which the cooling model should treat as an air-side load.

max_coolant_supply_c.note: not applicable: no coolant to the servers. Supply air 10-35 C (B300 rack spec; 10-30 C per the DGX B300 user guide). RDHx water limits depend on the chosen RDHx model.

rack_pressure_drop_kpa.note: not applicable: no liquid loop to the servers; RDHx pressure drop depends on the chosen model

depth_mm.note: excluding rear door heat exchanger; NVIDIA's drawing shows a ~432 mm (17 in) RDHx on the rear

weight_kg.note: NVIDIA estimate for the 4-system DC-busbar rack, excluding RDHx. Per server: 123 kg busbar version, 168 kg with PSUs (DGX B300 user guide).

feet.note: MGX rack with casters and four corner leveling feet assumed (casters visible in NVIDIA drawing)

service_clearance_front_mm.note: NVIDIA MGX rack front clearance for IT component servicing (33 in)

service_clearance_rear_mm.note: read from NVIDIA's RDHx clearance drawing: ~432 mm RDHx plus 609 mm (24 in) beyond it; RDHx dimensions vary by model

scale_out_ports.note: 8 OSFP ConnectX-8 ports per server x 4 servers; BlueField-3 storage/in-band ports not counted

scale_up_domain.note: NVLink domain is one 8-GPU server; the rack holds four separate domains

scale_up_bandwidth_tbps.note: 14.4 TB/s aggregate NVLink per 8-GPU server (1.8 TB/s per GPU) = 115.2 Tb/s per domain

switch_slots.note: compute rack; 48U fully used by 4 servers and power shelves

compute.accelerator_model: NVIDIA B300 SXM (Blackwell Ultra, 288 GB HBM3e)

hbm_tb.note: 4 x 2.3 TB (8 x 288 GB) per DGX B300; NVIDIA's HGX page lists 2.1 TB per board, i.e. 8.4 TB

fp4_pflops.note: 4 x 108 PFLOPS dense FP4 per HGX B300 (144 PFLOPS sparse)

fp8_pflops.note: 4 x 36 PFLOPS dense FP8 (NVIDIA lists 72 sparse; dense is half)

sources.title: NVIDIA Data Center Best Practices with DGX B300 (rack specifications, power provisioning, service clearances)
